user.title: MeteoVeo
user.description:
Forecast for your home, rain in the next hour and official weather warnings for Spain — with or without a weather station.

[Setup guide]({docs_url})

menu_options.station_key: I have a station ID and key (advanced)

station_key.title: Connect with a station key
station_key.description:
Enter the station ID and key shown on your station's page at {signup_url}. This option is for stations already set up on the MeteoVeo website.

[Setup guide]({docs_url})

data_description.station_id: The MV… identifier shown on your station's page. It is not secret and never changes.
data_description.station_key: The secret generated on the station's page. Creating a new key invalidates the old one immediately.

create_account.title: Create your MeteoVeo account
create_account.description:
It's free. We'll email you a code to confirm the address. Your password goes to MeteoVeo once and is not stored in Home Assistant.

Read the [terms of use]({terms_url}) and the [privacy policy]({privacy_url}).

[Setup guide]({docs_url})

data.accept_terms: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy
data.marketing: Send me MeteoVeo news by email

data_description.email: The confirmation code is sent here. It is also how you sign in.
data_description.marketing: Optional. You can unsubscribe at any time.

verify_code.title: Check your email
verify_code.description:
We sent a 6-digit code to {email}; it is valid for 24 hours. It can take a minute — check the spam folder too.

If this address already has an account, you'll get an email saying so instead of a code: close this window and choose "I already have an account".

[Setup guide]({docs_url})

login.title: Sign in to MeteoVeo
login.description:
Sign in with your MeteoVeo email and password. The password is not stored in Home Assistant.

Did you create your account with Google, Apple or a passkey? Set a password first in the MeteoVeo app (Account → Password), or use the station-key option.

[Setup guide]({docs_url})

data_description.email: The address you signed up with.

location.title: Where do you want the forecast for?
location.description:
Your Home Assistant home is preselected; move the pin to change it. MeteoVeo covers Spain, including the Balearic and Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla. The place is stored rounded to about 1 km.

[Setup guide]({docs_url})

data_description.location: Drag the pin, or leave it on your home.

has_station.title: Weather station
has_station.description:
If Home Assistant already reads a weather station, it can share the readings with MeteoVeo. In return you get extras for your station, such as which forecast model works best there. Without a station you get the forecast all the same.

[Setup guide]({docs_url})

data.has_station: Do you have a weather station in Home Assistant?

data_description.has_station: Leave it off if you don't have one.

station_details.title: Your station
station_details.description:
Readings are uploaded once a minute, over HTTPS.

[About the measurements]({docs_url})

data_description.station_name: How the station appears to you in MeteoVeo.
data_description.sensor_height_cm: Height of the temperature sensor above the ground, in centimetres (usually 150–200).

measurements.title: Which entity feeds which measurement
measurements.description:
Leave a measurement empty if your station does not report it. One entity per measurement.

[About the measurements]({docs_url})

data_description.pressure: Station-level (absolute) pressure in hPa, mbar or inHg. The service reduces it to sea level itself — do not pick an already reduced value.
data_description.wind_speed: Sustained wind speed, in any common unit.
data_description.wind_gust: Peak wind gust, in any common unit.
data_description.daily_rain: Rain accumulated since midnight — not the rain rate.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter the new station key
reauth_confirm.description:
The previous key stopped working. Generate a new one on the station's settings page and paste it here.

[Troubleshooting]({docs_url})

data_description.station_key: The new key from the station's page. The old key stopped working the moment it was replaced.

reauth_login.title: Sign in again
reauth_login.description:
MeteoVeo no longer accepts this connection's key. Sign in to issue a new one; the place, the station and the entities stay as they are.

[Troubleshooting]({docs_url})

data_description.email: The account this connection was set up with.

delete_account.title: Delete my MeteoVeo account
delete_account.description:
This cannot be undone. Your account, profile and photos, and your stations' names and keys, are deleted, and every Home Assistant connection to the account stops working. Readings already sent stay, anonymously.

An App Store or Google Play subscription is **not** cancelled by this — cancel it in the store.

No password on your account (Google, Apple or passkey)? Delete it in the MeteoVeo app instead.

[Troubleshooting]({docs_url})

data.confirm: Type your email again to confirm

data_description.confirm: The account is deleted only if this matches the email above.
